definitions.explanation: A long, thin piece of wood or other material.
A straight line drawn on paper.

examples.english: I drew a line on the ground with a stick.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鉄|てつ}{棒|ぼう}→てつぼう：17912_tetsubou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ぶら{下|さ}がる→ぶらさがる：05541_burasagaru⟧。
examples.english: To hang from an iron bar.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→こども：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{棒|ぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}り{回|まわ}して→ふりまわす：06051_furimawasu⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいる→あそぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: The child is playing by swinging a stick around.

examples.japanese: ⟦せっかく→せっかく：04361_sekkaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→どりょく：03490_doryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{棒|ぼう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{振|ふ}って→ふる：01983_furu⟧⟦しまった→てしまう：03102_teshimau⟧。
examples.english: I ended up wasting all my hard work.
examples.notes: {棒|ぼう}に{振|ふ}る = to waste, throw away

examples.japanese: {棒|ぼう}⟦グラフ→グラフ：04864_gurafu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→つくる：00481_tsukuru⟧。

examples.english: I crossed out the name by drawing a line over it.

examples.japanese: {棒読|ぼうよ}み⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{台詞|せりふ}→せりふ：04038_serifu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}った→いう：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: I said the lines in a monotone.
examples.notes: {棒読|ぼうよ}み = flat, monotone reading

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}い→あかい：00585_akai⟧{棒|ぼう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{青|あお}い→あおい：00586_aoi⟧{棒|ぼう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{比較|ひかく}→ひかく：03576_hikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{表|あらわ}す→あらわす：01868_arawasu⟧⟦グラフ→グラフ：04864_gurafu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いた→かく：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I drew a graph that shows the comparison using red and blue bars.

notes:
A basic word with many compound uses.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・⟦{鉄棒|てつぼう}→てつぼう：17912_tetsubou⟧ (horizontal bar - gymnastics)
・{棒|ぼう}⟦グラフ→グラフ：04864_gurafu⟧ (bar graph)
・⟦{泥棒|どろぼう}→どろぼう：01688_dorobou⟧ (thief)
・⟦{相棒|あいぼう}→あいぼう：noentry⟧ (partner, sidekick)
・{棒読|ぼうよ}み (monotone reading)
・{棒|ぼう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{振|ふ}る→ふる：01983_furu⟧ (to waste, throw away)

IDIOMS:
・{棒|ぼう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{振|ふ}る→ふる：01983_furu⟧ (to waste something - effort, money)
・⟦{犬|いぬ}→いぬ：00632_inu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{歩|ある}けば→あるく：00538_aruku⟧{棒|ぼう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→あたる：01860_ataru⟧ (A dog that walks will bump into a stick - you'll encounter fortune/misfortune if you go out)
